title: JetBrains task detail shows any latest check as "Reported check passed", even a run the delivery policy does not count
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate (task-808869c5, client-contract check). deliveryProjection serves latestCheckRun as {command, exitCode} of the LAST run recorded on the current candidate. It carries no `source`, and it does not say whether the run is the required gate. delivery/policy.ts counts only runner-observed exit-0 runs of the trimmed gate command.

So the detail view can read "Reported check passed - exit code 0" for an agent-reported run while qa_approve refuses required-check:<gate>. It can also show a later failing non-gate run although the gate passed. The label honestly says "Reported", but nothing tells the reader whether the policy counts that run.
definitionOfDone: The daemon projection serves the run's source and whether delivery/policy.ts counts it for the required check (or the required-check status itself), with a daemon test
JetBrains parses and renders it, pinned by a headless presentation test, and an agent-reported or non-gate pass never reads as a satisfied required check
VS Code keeps ignoring the field without error (npm test + compile)

implementationPlan.description:
Implement the projection. In checkFor, when the latest valid check has source exactly 'runner-observed' or 'agent-reported', include it; otherwise omit source (do not drop command/exitCode). Do not require source in the valid() predicate.

Add requiredCheckSatisfiedFor(state, task): boolean | undefined:
- try/catch around resolveDeliveryPolicy + evaluateDeliveryEvidence (import from ../delivery/policy.js plus REQUIRED_CHECK_TOKEN_PREFIX and requiredCheckCommand). On throw, logger.debug like readEvidence and return undefined — error handling so a bad setting cannot take down the board.
- legacy → undefined.
- missingEvidence has a token starting with REQUIRED_CHECK_TOKEN_PREFIX → false.
- else if requiredCheckCommand(state, task) !== null → true.
- else undefined.
Include the field in the returned object only when the helper returns boolean.

Re-run `npx vitest run src/state/deliveryProjection.test.ts`; expect PASS.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN. checkFor serves source only when it is exactly runner-observed/agent-reported (isCheckSource); valid() predicate unchanged, so rows with a bad source still serve command/exitCode. requiredCheckSatisfiedFor(state, task) runs evaluateDeliveryEvidence inside the existing readEvidence (debug log + undefined on throw, so an unrecognised deliveryPolicy cannot take down /ws); legacy -> undefined; a required-check:<cmd> OR 'unreadable-required-check' token -> false; else checkOwed ? true : undefined. checkOwed mirrors policy.ts checkShortfall's pick (DONE/ARCHIVED + requiredCheckAtDone !== undefined -> non-blank string snapshot, else live requiredCheckCommand) — DEVIATION from the plan's live-only rule, needed because sibling fd970f24 (97df78f) already snapshots the check at DONE; policy.ts itself untouched. Verdict computed only after the no-evidence early return, so evidence-free tasks stay byte-identical and cost nothing. Field included only when boolean. completionSummary:
The daemon's /ws delivery projection (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/deliveryProjection.ts) now serves two more things. First, latestCheckRun.source, but only when it is exactly runner-observed or agent-reported. Other values are omitted and the run is still served. Second, a separate requiredCheckSatisfied boolean, which is the delivery policy's verdict and not the latest run's: false while evaluateDeliveryEvidence reports a required-check:<cmd> or unreadable-required-check token, true when a check is owed and satisfied. It is omitted under the legacy policy, when no check is owed (autoCommit=false, blank gate), when the deliveryPolicy is unrecognised (caught by readEvidence, so it does not throw), and for tasks with no evidence (still byte-identical).

Deviation from the plan: sibling fd970f24 has landed (97df78f). So "owed" copies policy.ts checkShortfall's choice: a DONE/ARCHIVED requiredCheckAtDone snapshot first, then the live requiredCheckCommand. Otherwise a DONE task with a null or malformed snapshot would read as counted. policy.ts is untouched (0-line diff).

JetBrains: DeliveryCheckRun.source and TaskDelivery.requiredCheckSatisfied. MoeJson keeps only the exact source values and a real JSON boolean. DeliveryPresentation keeps checkPassed/Failed as the reported rows and adds checkSource plus requiredCheckCounted (yes, PASS) or requiredCheckNotCounted (no, FAIL). There is no row when the verdict is null. Three bundle keys added.
